Method of Attack: Email phishing campaign delivering malware-laced documents with macros that install BazarLoader malware
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with phone numbers to call and malicious Excel documents with macros
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing emails pretending to be payment card charge notifications
Fake streaming service websites such as 'BravoMovies' by 'UrbanCinema'
Campaign tracked as BazaFlix by Proofpoint
